tools.name: list_connectors
tools.description: List every MCP connector ConnectorReport has tested hands-on, with status, pass rate and last test date. Optional category: ai-ml, cloud, developer-tools, docs, other, productivity, public-data, search, travel.

tools.name: get_connector_report
tools.description: Full hands-on test report for one connector by slug: status, pass rate, tested date, each task, gotchas, fix recipes and page URL.

tools.name: check_connector_status
tools.description: Current Connector Weather (Clear, Cloudy or Stormy) for a connector by name, plus the last test date. Check this before relying on a connector.

tools.name: compare_connectors
tools.description: Side-by-side hands-on results for 2 to 10 connector slugs.

tools.name: search_reports
tools.description: Full-text search across tested connectors, task details, run notes and gotchas, for example "OAuth" or "token".
